name: wyzie-mcp

tools.name: search_subtitles
tools.description: Search subtitles for a movie or episode by IMDb/TMDB id. Returns a compact JSON list (id, language, display, format, release, fileName, source, isHearingImpaired, downloadCount, match, quality, url). Costs 1 request. Pass a result's url to download_subtitle. Needs an API key.

id.description: IMDb id (tt0111161) or TMDB id (286217). Use search_tmdb to turn a title into an id.

season.description: Season number. Must be given together with episode.

episode.description: Episode number. Must be given together with season.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, es. Comma separated for several (en,es).

format.description: srt, ass, vtt, sub... Comma separated for several.

source.description: Source codename(s), see list_sources. Default: all.

video.description: Video file name, e.g. Show.S02E03.1080p.WEB-DL-GROUP.mkv. Ranks results by fit and fills match.

hash.description: OpenSubtitles movie hash (16 hex digits) of the video file.

tools.name: get_best_subtitle
tools.description: Get the single best subtitle for an id: text formats first, non hearing-impaired first (unless hi=true), never AI-generated. Returns one object or the text 'none'. Costs 1 request. Prefer this over search_subtitles when you only need one file.

id.description: IMDb id (tt0111161) or TMDB id (286217). Use search_tmdb to turn a title into an id.

season.description: Season number. Must be given together with episode.

episode.description: Episode number. Must be given together with season.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, es. Comma separated for several (en,es).

format.description: srt, ass, vtt, sub... Comma separated for several.

source.description: Source codename(s), see list_sources. Default: all.

video.description: Video file name, e.g. Show.S02E03.1080p.WEB-DL-GROUP.mkv. Ranks results by fit and fills match.

hash.description: OpenSubtitles movie hash (16 hex digits) of the video file.

tools.name: download_subtitle
tools.description: Download a subtitle's text from the url of a search result, optionally converting (to), shifting timing (offset/shift), fixing fps, stripping styling (plain), reflowing lines. Costs 1 request. Output is cut at 60000 characters.

url.description: The url field of a search_subtitles or get_best_subtitle result.

to.description: Output format. txt = text only, json = cues with seconds.

offset.description: Shift all cues by this many seconds (negative = earlier).

shift.description: Alias of offset: +2.5s, -1500ms, -00:00:02.500. Wins over offset.

plain.description: Strip styling codes, drop empty and repeated cues.

dual.description: ISO 639-1 code: add a second language under each line (Pro, +1 request).

lines.description: Reflow cues to at most this many characters per line.

maxlines.description: Max lines per cue when reflowing (default 2).

mindur.description: Minimum cue display time in seconds.

tools.name: get_subtitle_file
tools.description: One call: find the best subtitle for an id and return its text (GET /download). Costs 2 requests. Same search parameters as search_subtitles (language defaults to en) plus the download options. Returns the text plus the picked release, source and language.

id.description: IMDb id (tt0111161) or TMDB id (286217). Use search_tmdb to turn a title into an id.

season.description: Season number. Must be given together with episode.

episode.description: Episode number. Must be given together with season.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en, es. Comma separated for several (en,es).

format.description: srt, ass, vtt, sub... Comma separated for several.

source.description: Source codename(s), see list_sources. Default: all.

video.description: Video file name, e.g. Show.S02E03.1080p.WEB-DL-GROUP.mkv. Ranks results by fit and fills match.

hash.description: OpenSubtitles movie hash (16 hex digits) of the video file.

to.description: Output format. txt = text only, json = cues with seconds.

offset.description: Shift all cues by this many seconds (negative = earlier).

shift.description: Alias of offset: +2.5s, -1500ms, -00:00:02.500. Wins over offset.

plain.description: Strip styling codes, drop empty and repeated cues.

dual.description: ISO 639-1 code: add a second language under each line (Pro, +1 request).

lines.description: Reflow cues to at most this many characters per line.

maxlines.description: Max lines per cue when reflowing (default 2).

mindur.description: Minimum cue display time in seconds.

tools.name: search_batch
tools.description: Search many titles in one call (1 to 50 items). Each item is an id (string or number) or an object with id, season, episode, language, format, source, hi, video, hash, sort, limit. Top-level language/format/source/hi/best are defaults. Costs 1 request per item. With best=true each item returns one subtitle or null.

best.description: true: only the best subtitle per item.

tools.name: search_quote
tools.description: Find the movie or episode a line of dialogue is said in. Returns up to 10 matches (imdbId, title, year, season, episode, timeMs, line, context). Costs 1 request.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the live subtitle sources (codenames usable as the source parameter) with tier and tags. With a key it also says which ones the key may use. Free.

tools.name: list_translation_languages
tools.description: List the languages AI translation can produce, as {code, name} pairs. Free, no key.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Wyzie Subs status and uptime: overall state, each source, uptime over 24h/7d/30d/90d, recent incidents. Free, no key.

days.description: Days of per-day history to include (default 0).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your key's balance, plan, daily usage and a per-day breakdown by route and source. Free (costs no requests). Needs a full key, not a browser key.

tools.name: search_tmdb
tools.description: Search TMDB by title to get the id for search_subtitles. Returns id, mediaType (movie or tv), title, releaseYear. Free, no key.

q.description: Title to look up, e.g. 'Breaking Bad'.

tools.name: extract_subtitles
tools.description: Pull embedded subtitle tracks out of a local video file (mkv, mp4, webm, mks...). Use list=true first to see the tracks (costs 1 request), then track or language to get one as text (1 request per track). Files over 100 MB are refused: extract just the subtitle streams first with ffmpeg -i movie.mkv -map 0:s -c copy subs.mks. Image-based tracks (PGS, VobSub) cannot be extracted.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local media file on this machine.

list.description: true: only list the tracks as JSON.

track.description: Subtitle stream number from the list.

language.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-2 code to pick the first text track in that language.

to.description: Output format. txt = text only, json = cues with seconds.

offset.description: Shift all cues by this many seconds (negative = earlier).

shift.description: Alias of offset: +2.5s, -1500ms, -00:00:02.500. Wins over offset.

plain.description: Strip styling codes, drop empty and repeated cues.

dual.description: ISO 639-1 code: add a second language under each line (Pro, +1 request).

lines.description: Reflow cues to at most this many characters per line.

maxlines.description: Max lines per cue when reflowing (default 2).

mindur.description: Minimum cue display time in seconds.

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Transcribe speech in a local audio or video file into subtitles. EXPENSIVE: costs 6000 requests per started 30 minutes of audio (60000 with speakers) and needs a Pro key. Waits until the job is done (can take minutes). Files over 100 MB are refused: send audio only. Only use when the user asked for a transcription.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local audio or video file.

speakers.description: Label speakers. 10x the price; needs language set to de en es fr hi it ja nl pt ru.

translate.description: Also translate into this language code (+25 requests).
